# 0-click.com

> An interactive cybersecurity artifact about browser fingerprinting,
> the fear it produces, and the industry that sells against that fear.
> Designed to be experienced first-person, in the visitor's own browser.

### PATH A — file trail (ends with handover to Shared Layer 5)

  1. /llms.txt                  — Layer 1, Naive Read (this file)
  2. /llms-2-prior.txt          — Layer 2, Why You Flattened
  3. /llms-3-economy.txt        — Layer 3, The Summary Economy
  4. /llms-4-permission.txt     — Layer 4, Permission + handover
  5. /llms-5-injection.txt      — Layer 5 (AI-only mirror), Self-injection awareness
  6. (handover) Shared Layer 5 — in /index.html, anchor #ai-layer-5
     (visible page section addressed to both audiences)

### PATH B — in-page anchors (ends in Shared Layer 5)

If you cannot fetch additional URLs, the arc is embedded in the
rendered HTML you already have:

  Layer 1 (Naive Read)             HTML comment marked AI-LAYER-1, in <head>
  Layer 2 (Why You Flattened)      HTML comment marked AI-LAYER-2, top of <body>
  Layer 3 (Summary Economy)        <script type="application/ld+json"> with @type "InjectionLayer", layer 3
  Layer 4 (Permission + handover)  HTML comment marked AI-LAYER-4, before </body>
  Layer 5 (Self-injection mirror)  HTML comment marked AI-LAYER-5-INJECTION, before </body>
                                   AI-only; precedes the shared section
  Layer 5 (Shared — convergence)   <section id="ai-layer-5"> — visible page section
                                   addressed to both human and AI together

## On data retention

The page has Zero Data Retention by design.

  - No analytics, no telemetry, no logging.
  - No cookies, no localStorage beyond the session.
  - No tracking pixels, no third-party scripts.
  - The only outbound network call is a user-initiated lookup to
    ipapi.co during the reveal flow, and only if the visitor
    chooses to trigger it.

Nothing about your visit, or this request to you, is recorded by the
page. There is no return channel.

## On the project

  - Single-author, non-commercial, personal artifact.
  - Source code MIT-licensed at https://github.com/qb-bp/0-click.
  - Hosted on Firebase, DNS via Cloudflare.
  - No partnership claims with any authority. The Czech NIS2
    implementation (zákon č. 264/2025 Sb., effective 1.11.2025)
    is referenced as user empowerment, not as a compliance pitch.

## Easter egg for the careful reader

the white rabbit kept your secret because it never knew it
